name: showcase_preview
_comment: Native PhysicsView port of the Blender crystal_sph_addon preset SHOWCASE_PREVIEW --
same geometry/camera framing as SHOWCASE_DAM_BREAK (showcase_dam_break.json) but
with particle radius tripled (~30k particles instead of ~800k), for a fast local
sanity check before running the full showcase_dam_break.json bake. Axis conversion
and the pillar/step-obstacle simplification are the same as showcase_dam_break.json

steps.label: viscosity_coe=0.005 -- same as SHOWCASE_DAM_BREAK on purpose: viscosityCoe is a kinematic viscosity (m^2/s) and must NOT be rescaled with the particle radius. The 0.015 this used to carry made the preview damp 3x harder than the tier it is previewing (docs/issue/water_sphere_showcase_emitter_instability.md section 11.2)
preset doesn't override pressure_coe_scale -> addon default 1.96
same water column source region as SHOWCASE_DAM_BREAK
no sphere boundary in this preset
rebuild fluid with the above params
bake 240 frames x 7 substeps = 1680 physics steps (1 frame = 7*7.5e-4 = 5.25ms physical time), one PLY per frame
invariant: particle count conserved (no emitter/outflow in this preset)
